# fqf060420 — tutor / runtime / teaching / evaluation module dependencies

No additional runtime dependencies beyond the project's existing product deps
(jsonschema, fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, starlette, httpx).

The local model adapters (runtime/local_model.py, runtime/async_model.py) use
httpx (already in product deps) plus the standard library (urllib, socket,
ipaddress) to talk to an OpenAI-compatible loopback endpoint. No paid service,
no cloud fallback, no model download: the endpoint is configured only through
C2C_MODEL_BASE_URL / C2C_MODEL_ID / C2C_MODEL_API_KEY /
C2C_MODEL_NETWORK_AUTHORIZED via ProviderSettings (full_learning/providers.py).
The API key is read by the backend only and is never logged, serialized into
exceptions, persisted, or sent to the browser. tutor/full.py and teaching/
add pydantic (product dep) and standard-library modules only.

## Test dependencies

Tests use only the existing dev deps (pytest, httpx). Async adapter behaviour
is covered with synthetic httpx transports / local HTTP doubles; no real model
endpoint, no network, and no pytest-asyncio are required, keeping
pyproject.toml untouched. Real-model runs are reported separately as
REAL_RUN evidence (see issues #78/#79/#80) and are never required by tests.

## Hardware boundary

deploy/dgx is documentation-only (runtime support notes and capacity
estimates). No DGX hardware acceptance has been run; status NOT_RUN per the
module task (#13, #68 C8).
